ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Alkali Metals Limited held its 58th Annual General Meeting, where shareholders considered crucial items including the adoption of FY2025-26 financial statements, dividend declaration, and the re-appointment of the Managing Director and other key directors. However, all voting results are explicitly stated as pending, meaning the definitive outcomes and material impacts on company governance and financials are not yet known. A minor governance observation is the reported absence of two directors whose re-appointments were on the agenda.
